info.title: Otto AI x402 — Market Intelligence, DeFi & Trading
info.description: Otto AI runs a swarm of autonomous agents exposing 88 pay-per-call services on x402 V2 across eight capability tags — Market & Token Intelligence, DeFi & Markets Data, Web & Domain Intelligence, Real-World Data, AI Creative & Tools, Portfolio & Accounts, Execution, and x402 Open Router. Settled in USDC on Base on every endpoint; 68 of 88 also accept USDC on Solana (each path's x-payment-info.networks names its own; the live 402's accepts[] is authoritative). Permit2-ready for any ERC-20. From $0.001 per call.
info.x-guidance:
Otto AI exposes 88 pay-per-call endpoints across eight capability tags — Market & Token Intelligence, DeFi & Markets Data, Web & Domain Intelligence, Real-World Data, AI Creative & Tools, Portfolio & Accounts, Execution, and x402 Open Router. All endpoints require x402 V2 payment in USDC. Settled in USDC on Base on every endpoint; 68 of 88 also accept USDC on Solana (each path's x-payment-info.networks names its own; the live 402's accepts[] is authoritative).

How to use:
1. GET/POST any endpoint — receive 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64-encoded) and the same accepts[] inlined in the JSON body
2. Read accepts[] for this path's payment options (EIP-3009 USDC on Base, Permit2 any ERC-20 on Base, and on 68 paths Solana USDC) — per-path networks are also published as x-payment-info.networks
3. Sign payment and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header
4. Receive 200 with data + signed receipt in PAYMENT-RESPONSE header
5. Only for endpoints that advertise SIWX eligibility: use SIGN-IN-WITH-X on subsequent requests (1hr free access); cached data endpoints require payment every call

Endpoint categories:
- Market & Token Intelligence (19): News (full feed, one-paragraph recaps, Base-ecosystem vertical), KOL sentiment, token analysis/details/fundamentals/price/security, trending, top-holders, holder analytics, Base Season, RH Season, tokenized-stock movers (Robinhood Chain + Base B20), tweet-search, mega-report
- DeFi & Markets Data (37): DeFi TVL/yield, stablecoin peg-watch, composite market-risk score (depeg + Base exit-liquidity), protocol fees/revenue, DEX pool search, one-hour Uniswap pool APR, trending pools, prediction-market odds (Polymarket top/crypto/search), funding rates, perp/HL market data, TradFi macro, US equities intel, tokenized-equity registry, SEC insider trades (Form 4), 13F institutional holdings, smart-money bundle + AI filing brief
- Web & Domain Intelligence (9): DNS lookup (records + SPF/DMARC/DKIM email auth), WHOIS/RDAP registration, domain age/trust signal, one-call domain report, web-search (query → ranked live pages + snippets), web-answer (quick synthesized answer + citations for agent loops; use /llm-research for a deep report), web-extract (URL → markdown via Jina), web-links (all page links) and web-json-extract (page → structured JSON via AI) — keyless public infra (DoH, RDAP, Jina, Cloudflare Browser Rendering) plus licensed Exa search/answer
- Real-World Data (2): live + reference fiat FX rates (Yahoo near-real-time mid for 12 majors refreshed every minute + ECB daily reference for ~30 currencies, base USD) and global current weather + 5-day forecast (Open-Meteo) — keyless public sources
- AI Creative & Tools (4): Image gen, video gen, AI research, tx explainer
- Portfolio & Accounts (10): Wallet balances/holdings bagcheck, Uniswap NFT range diagnostics, positions, transaction history, yield positions, idle capital
- Execution (4): Swap (LI.FI), bridge (LI.FI), deposit, withdraw, Hyperliquid perps (trade/close/modify/margin/deposit-withdraw)
- x402 Open Router (3): Meta Intelligence (POST /meta-intelligence, or GET /meta-intelligence?ask= — recommends the best x402 service, non-custodial, $0.001), Full Auto (POST /full-auto — LIVE+ARMED, pays the best service on your behalf at-cost + $0.001 router fee, upto cap), Feedback & Refunds (POST /feedback — money-back guarantee, capped $0.01/tx, up to 10x/wallet/day, on Otto's own services + Full Auto)

PoolAprIdentity.description: Exact provider-bound pool identity. Tokens must be distinct and sorted numerically; V3 uses a 20-byte pool address and zero hook, V4 a 32-byte PoolId. Identity matching is not a token or hook safety approval.

LpAdviceYield.description: Uniswap-reported pool APR in percentage points, independently cached for one hour. Source computation timestamp and lookback are unspecified; retrievedAt is the original local retrieval time. Expired observations survive failed refreshes as STALE for up to 24 hours. Missing optional reward evidence does not erase a reported fee or total APR. Overall freshness reflects the oldest displayed component; components expose their own clocks. Range inactivity or blocked advice does not suppress correctly bound pool statistics. This does not establish personal earnings or investment eligibility.

PoolAssessment.description: Independent, block-bound technical pool assessment, cached for at most five minutes from the source block. CURRENT describes evidence freshness, not a safe pool or recommendation. ELIGIBLE_FOR_COMPARISON admits a pool to further comparison only: investment suitability, fee profitability and execution safety are not established. Nonzero hook behavior remains UNASSESSED; permission bits and code hashes are descriptive evidence. Missing/RPC-failed assessment never erases independent APR statistics.

advisory.description: User objective and comparison horizon only. Data providers, volatility, costs and forecasts cannot be supplied by callers.

uncollectedFeesRaw.description: V4 accrued fee entitlement; V3 fresh fee growth since last checkpoint only. V3 stored balances are separate and are not assumed to be income.

anyOf.description: V4 pool ID and key, or explicit V3 pool address in id/address with currency/fee/spacing metadata. All reads are bound to the snapshot block.

tokensOwedRaw.description: V3 stored collectable tokens, which may include withdrawn capital and fees. Unclassified without lifecycle history.

IntelligenceRecordedEvidence.description: Separately dated server-owned, hash-pinned accounting export. Gross quoted output is not a current executable exit or net USD profit. Claimable and pending rewards retain their own observation and computation times.

volatility.description: Server-bound hourly V3 geometric-TWAP evidence with status, annualized decimal volatility, exact snapshot/pool/token bindings, source block, averaging and return windows, observation times, reasons and assumptions. Unavailable results contain status and reasons. This is a limited smoothed proxy, never calibrated implied volatility.

incrementalFeeHurdleBeforeExecutionCosts.description: Conditional candidate divergence cost minus keep divergence cost over the selected horizon, in the displayed quote token. Positive means this much more fee income is required; negative means the model allows this much less fee income before execution costs. Add full execution costs to obtain the fee hurdle after costs. This is a required fee difference, never a fee forecast or expected profit.

LpAdviceEligibility.description: Additional advisory checks on the reader-validated current snapshot. Discovery membership never supplies this status. DIAGNOSTICS_ONLY permits conditional range analysis, not an LP recommendation, deposit approval or token safety certification. Unknown address, inconsistent metadata, unavailable applicable token status or unsupported pool blocks range guidance while preserving observed balances.

baseToken.description: Exact address of the displayed base asset; may be pool token1 for USDG-first pools.

quoteToken.description: Exact address of the displayed quote asset and valuation numeraire; may be pool token0.

valuationToken.description: Exact address of the quote asset in which principalValue, deltaValueInQuote, gammaValueInQuote and expectedDivergenceCost are denominated.

baseAmount.description: Human units of baseToken, not pool-order token0.

quoteAmount.description: Human units of quoteToken, not pool-order token1.

baseDelta.description: Derivative of quote-denominated principal value with respect to the quote-per-base price; units of baseToken.

deltaValueInQuote.description: Price times baseDelta, denominated in quoteToken; not necessarily USD.

gammaValueInQuote.description: Price squared times second price derivative of principal value, denominated in quoteToken; not necessarily USD.
